name: Pentadiplandraceae

img.author: Wildeman, E. de, died 24 July 1947 see Wildeman, E. de (Emile) 1866-1947

desc: Pentadiplandra brazzeana, also known as oubli, is an evergreen shrub or liana that is the only species assigned to the genus Pentadiplandra, and has been placed in a family of its own called Pentadiplandraceae.
